fields.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Azir''' summons a {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} at the target location that is {{tip|untargetable}}, lasts 10 seconds, and grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings. The {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} expires twice as fast while within range of an enemy {{tip|turret}}, and does so instantly if '''Azir''' is too far away.

'''Azir''' periodically [[stock]]s a {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}}, up to a maximum of 2.
fields.description2: When '''Azir''' declares a basic attack against an enemy in a soldier's {{sti|attack range}}, the {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} attacks in his stead, thrusting their spear in the target's direction to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies struck in a line. Against the primary target, the {{as|Sand Soldier's|buzzword2}} attack applies {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects, with on-hit damage reduced to 50% effectiveness. Targets hit beyond the closest take {{pp|20; then +8*x for 10|1;9 to 18|formula=20% at level 1, then +8% per level starting at level 9 and capped at level 18|key=%}}<!--stops at 18--> damage. Subsequent {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}} attacks against the same target deal 25% damage without applying {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|on-attack}} effects.
fields.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{pplevel|0; then +8*x|1;10+(x-1)|formula=0 at level 1, then +8 per level starting at level 10}} (+ {{ap|50 to 110}}) {{as|(+ {{ap|35 to 65}}% AP)}}}}
fields.notes:
* Soldiers' attacks deal {{tip|area damage}}; against the main target, the damage is additionally tagged as {{tip|basic damage}}.
** If a soldier's attack hits multiple champions, it will deal damage to them in order of their appearance in the pre-game [[Loading Screen]], the order of which may matter for some effects that trigger just once for the first target hit.
* '''Azir''' must rank ''Arise!'' as his first ability, and will do so automatically if he reaches level 2 before ranking an ability.
* '''Azir''' can only command his soldiers to attack if he is able to declare [[basic attack]] commands himself, meaning {{tip|crowd control}} effects that disable attacking, such as {{tip|disarm}}, do not allow him to order his soldiers to attack in his stead.
* {{tip|Nearsight|Nearsighting}} effects will only allow '''Azir''' to perform attacks from soldiers within his own sight radius.
* Commanding a soldier to attack will trigger {{tip|on-attack}} effects, but will not apply any of these effects to the target hit.
** The attacks do not apply {{sti|life steal}}.
** {{tip|Energized}} will stack but not be consumed.
** {{ii|Sundered Sky}} does not apply.
*** However it does apply with {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}} for secondary targets if the main target is a champion.
* Damage to enemy champions from ''Sand Soldier'' stabs will draw minion aggro even if the enemy champion was not the primary target.{{bug|2}}
* {{as|Sand Soldiers|buzzword2}} can damage {{ai|Powder Keg|Gangplank|Powder Kegs}}, {{ai|Prophet of an Elder God|Illaoi|Tentacles}}, and {{ai|Sentinel|Kalista|Sentinels}}, but only if they are the main target of the attack.
* {{as|Sand Soldiers|buzzword2}} will attack the closest enemy to '''Azir''' when using attack move (or {{sbc|A + RMB}} / {{sbc|Shift + RMB}}) or {{tip|acquisition radius|auto-attack}}.
* If an enemy has {{tip|sight|vision}} of a {{as|Sand Soldier|buzzword2}}, they will also gain vision of '''Azir''' even if he is out of sight.
* While {{ii|Navori Flickerblade}} is equipped, if '''Azir''' has 1 ''Arise!'' charge ready, the recharge timer will appear to restart when triggering {{nie|Transcendence}}{{bug}}; the recharge timer is incurred normally.

}}
